title: Robust variance estimation in the browser: validation of allmeta rve-meta against robumeta and clubSandwich
description: Validation archive for the allmeta rve-meta page (engine shared/rve.js + shared/stats-qt.js) against robumeta 2.1 robu(modelweights="CORR", small=TRUE) and clubSandwich 0.7.0 coef_test(vcov="CR2", test="Satterthwaite") in R 4.6.0 on 16,270 configurations. Page as committed on allmeta branch fix/rve-meta-cr2-parity-p15-v2, commit e042af5 (draft PR #146). allmeta release: [ALLMETA RELEASE PENDING]; allmeta release DOI: [ALLMETA RELEASE PENDING]. The documented strict result is not full strict agreement: 785 configurations fail the 1e-9 criterion, each with a recorded diagnosis.
